scope: Independent review of frozen supported-source privacy integration; no runtime operations or test reruns
findings: The exported cached-status classifier implementation is exactly equal to the owner-zero-tested research helper after header name/comment differences.
The exported link-status.h is byte-identical to the tested helper containing the eleven independent TrackLocation row masks.

The active sendto path copies only external IPv4, non-127/8, destination-port 50002, 1152-byte status candidates before applying auxiliary, committed/ticket and configured-source masks. Loopback clients retain complete local identity.
Auxiliary row masking runs before either current-source early return; an auxiliary-only change is also transmitted from the modified copy, preserving a native current-source tuple.
PROBE_COMMITTED_STATUS_ORIGIN is enabled. Committed physical load-origin classification does not require the native safe-eject owner; detach-ticket fallback still does.

Matched successful load completion retires the detach proof and sets committed_valid from source>=0 and origin_valid. Native/external replacement source<0 clears that classification even when content ID is unchanged.

The completion hook correlates native record pointer and admission epoch before and after native publication. Pending or failed replacements retain the committed origin; mode2 unload preserves it; exact real unload retires it.
New queue marker delays, forced asynchronous execution and injected Instant Doubles API test callers are absent from exported runtime C/header code.

pre_existing_control.behavior: Opt-in pause after native detach and before withdrawal; only nonzero values up to 10000 milliseconds take effect.
pre_existing_control.scope: Predates coexistence and remains unchanged; ordinary operation does not set it.
pre_existing_control.final_runtime_environment_confirmation: Independently reviewed frozen owner-collected /proc environment output: no AZHUB_ variables, including AZHUB_EJECT_TEST_PAUSE_MS, in native PID 22891 or inherited child PID 23293.

limits: This is source integration and activation-environment assurance; chosen final-binary packet privacy and native same-content replacement reporting remain pending.
The transmit selection conclusion applies to the installed exact-firmware sendto route; it is not a claim about arbitrary socket APIs or raw syscalls.
No claim that every historical debug control has been removed.
Known-field privacy evidence does not establish the semantics of every extended status byte.
